posts.title: Gerry Herron's second Hall of Hustler
posts.photo_alt: Gerry Herron's Hall of Hustlers certificate: 24 points in NAPA 9-Ball on October 12, 2026
posts.body:
With all the NAPA Nationals going on this week APEX Billiards co owner, Gerry Herron sneaks in an impressive 24 pointer and moves into a small club of repeat offenders! Great shooting Gerry.

24 points · NAPA 9-Ball · October 12, 2026

posts.title: Schedules and Team Hub are live
posts.body:
Every active division's schedule is now on the site, week by week, with scores added the morning after each league night.

The new Team Hub gives a team its own PIN-protected page with its next match, full schedule, and links. Team pages are set up on request. Captains, if you'd like one for your team, message us on Signal and we'll get it set up.
